intros: After months of planning, the move is done. Here is what changed, and what stays the same for the people we work with.
Working from different places has its challenges. These are the habits that made the biggest difference for our team.
We are happy to welcome two new colleagues. They bring experience in front-end development and content platforms.
A new design, a clearer structure and faster search: a look at the project from the first workshop to launch day.
An audit is more than a checklist. We share what we learned and the fixes that helped most visitors.
Launch days look calm from the outside. This is everything that happened in the weeks before.
Come and meet the team, see our work and ask your questions. Everyone is welcome, no registration needed.
Three languages, one structure. How we keep translated content in sync without slowing editors down.
paragraphs: It began with a simple question: what do our visitors need most, and how quickly can they find it? We looked at search terms, talked to the people who use the site every day and wrote down every answer.
From there we made small, careful changes. Every step was tested with real content before it went live, so nothing surprised the editors on the day itself.
The work isn't finished. Over the coming months we will keep measuring, listening and improving, and we will share what we learn along the way.
The new setup is easier to maintain and faster for visitors. Editors spend less time on layout and more time on what they want to say.

• Shorter pages with clearer headings
  • Images that load at the right size
  • Content that reads well on every screen
Have a question about this project or want to know more? Get in touch and we will happily tell you more.

quotes.text: The best projects start with listening, not with a design.
We wanted a site our editors enjoy using. That changed everything.
Small improvements, made every week, add up faster than one big launch.
